lede: Apple's new OLED MacBook Pro is in customers' hands, OpenAI has reportedly raised another $11 billion, and Israel's president has asked Netanyahu's rival to form the next government; Singapore AI startup news was thin, so that section has one story.
stocks_note: Latest closes: New York, Friday 6 November (AAPL, GOOGL) and SGX, Friday 6 November (DBS), via Yahoo Finance. No upcoming earnings dates turned up.

sections.title: Apple
sections.subtitle: Official news in brief, then 9to5Mac and MacRumors

official.label: From Apple
official.summary: Apple said more than 100,000 apps are now optimised for the iPhone Duo, two weeks after it went on sale. It also announced that its Carlsbad, California store will reopen in its original spot on 20 November after more than a year of renovation. Earlier this week it expanded language support in the redesigned Health app.

items.headline: iPhone Air 2 is due next spring, and it has a point to prove
items.summary: Apple is expected to unveil the second-generation iPhone Air in spring after going back to the drawing board and adding a second camera. The piece argues the slimmer phone has more to prove than ever after a lukewarm first outing.

items.headline: Apple Music Classical gets the new black-and-white icon
items.summary: Apple has updated Apple Music Classical so its icon matches the monochrome look recently given to the main Apple Music app. The change follows the redesign that replaced the familiar white note on a red background.

items.headline: First hands-on with Apple's OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.summary: MacRumors picked up one of the new machines on the day it reached customers and spent time with the OLED touch display. The site calls it Apple's PROLED MacBook Pro and shares first impressions of using a touchscreen on a Mac.

items.headline: Free Backglow app lets you customise the MacBook Pro's glowing Apple logo
items.summary: Designer Juan Buis has made an app that controls the illuminated Apple logo on the lid of the new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro. The free version lets you adjust the brightness by hand, with extra options behind a paid tier.

items.headline: SM Lee tells Australia to deepen ties with Asia
items.summary: Senior Minister Lee Hsien Loong said Australia should build closer links with Asia to give itself more room to pursue its own interests. He pointed to cooperation that would let countries see each other as development partners, not only through the lens of US-China rivalry.

items.headline: Illegal gambling site GemBet recruited money mules in Singapore
items.summary: The site hired people here to issue fake invoices that disguised illegal bets as ordinary business payments. Nine people were arrested earlier in connection with the operation, and the latest details show how the scheme tried to keep its payments looking legitimate.

items.headline: NUS creates a breast cancer genomics professorship named for a late patient
items.summary: The university has launched a professorship in breast cancer genomics, named after a patient who has died. Surgical oncologist Mikael Hartman is the first holder, and the chair is meant to support research into how genetic differences shape breast cancer.

items.headline: Union condemns abuse of public transport workers after bus driver allegedly threatened
items.summary: A passenger allegedly threatened the driver of service 136 along Ang Mo Kio Avenue 6 on 4 November. The union representing transport workers condemned the incident and called for abuse against frontline staff to stop.

items.headline: Bishan marketplace draws crowds for near-expiry and imperfect food
items.summary: Residents are queuing at Project Zero Waste Marketplace at Bishan Community Club, where near-expiry and cosmetically imperfect food is sold at a discount. The initiative has run since 2023 and is aimed at cutting food waste.

items.headline: Congress donations fall 75% to Rs 131 crore, a three-year low
items.summary: Donations to the Congress party dropped sharply to Rs 131 crore, the lowest in three years. The fall of about three-quarters marks a steep decline in the party's funding.

items.headline: Rajnath Singh urges top military readiness from an eastern airbase
items.summary: Speaking to personnel at a key airbase near the China frontier, the Defence Minister warned of evolving threats and of adversaries exploiting vulnerabilities. He also reviewed Army infrastructure along the Line of Actual Control.

items.headline: NDA sweeps Andhra Pradesh local body polls
items.summary: Counting in the ZPTC and MPTC elections showed the TDP winning 229 ZPTCs and 4,823 MPTCs by 9 p.m. Its allies Jana Sena and the BJP also won seats, while the YSRCP trailed far behind.

items.headline: Mamata Banerjee and BJP trade charges over attack on Abhishek Banerjee's home
items.summary: The alleged attack on the residence of the Trinamool Congress national general secretary has set off a sharp exchange between the TMC and the BJP. Each side blames the other for the incident.

items.headline: Why the week after Diwali is Delhi's biggest pollution test
items.summary: While attention centres on firecrackers, the article says the real health hazard comes from a mix of other factors building up in the background. It looks at why the days after the festival are the hardest for Delhi's air.

items.headline: Six killed in random shooting in Krakow's main square
items.summary: Police say six people died in the attack, and three more bodies were later found at the suspect's home. Poland's prime minister has pointed to far-right influence as investigators piece together what happened.

items.headline: Israel's president asks Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government
items.summary: Isaac Herzog gave the opposition leader 28 days to secure 61 Knesset seats. Neither Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor Eisenkot's won a majority in last week's election.

items.headline: New Zealand election leaves no clear winner
items.summary: Preliminary results point to a highly divided parliament. Weeks of coalition talks could follow before a government is formed.

items.headline: More than 140,000 rally in France over rising costs
items.summary: New protests swept the country, with tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon. The interior minister warned that authorities were ready for rioters and looters.

items.headline: US offers $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear programme
items.summary: The reward comes as Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the possibility of renewing strikes on Iran's nuclear sites.

brief.summary: Cohere and Singapore's Centre for Strategic Infocomm Technologies announced a partnership to run secure, enterprise-grade AI for national security work, following a pilot on on-premises systems. The Monetary Authority of Singapore opened its Future of Finance Institute, starting with AI in finance. A survey ranked Singapore first among Commonwealth countries for youth AI readiness.

sections.title: Singapore AI startups
sections.subtitle: Funding, hiring, and what they're building

items.headline: Singapore chip startup Symatics unveils an AI architecture
items.summary: Tech in Asia reports that Symatics, a Singapore chip startup, has unveiled a new AI computing architecture. The outlet's feed gave only the headline and I could not confirm further details elsewhere, so specifics are not included here.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly raises another $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summary: The money is part of a round that has not formally closed but is expected to within weeks. The reported valuation would put OpenAI well above any other private AI company.

items.headline: OpenAI changes its data centre approach after post-midterm backlash
items.summary: The company says it will make sure local residents do not pay for the electricity that powers its projects. The move follows voter anger over data centres in this week's US elections.

items.headline: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data centre project to Google
items.summary: Crusoe has handed its Wyoming site to Google. TechCrunch says the sale highlights how hard it is to develop very large AI data centres.

items.headline: Meta adds Spaces to its Muse AI agents
items.summary: Spaces gives users a place to organise projects and collaborate with their Muse agent. Mark Zuckerberg said Muse had 10 million users in the US and Canada less than two months after launch.

items.headline: What the midterms mean for the AI industry
items.summary: Democratic wins, plus 41 data-centre ballot measures decided on Tuesday, have the tech industry bracing for tougher scrutiny. TechCrunch's Equity podcast asks what that means for Elon Musk and for data centre builders.

items.headline: Chinese models led by Kimi dominate open-source enterprise AI spending
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi family and other Chinese models account for nearly nine-tenths of estimated global enterprise spending on open-source models, according to SCMP's report.

items.headline: China's AI chipmakers report their first profits
items.summary: Several pure-play AI chipmakers swung into profit in the third quarter, a milestone for the sector. SCMP asks whether it can last given severe supply constraints.

items.headline: Robotaxis are taking over China's cities
items.summary: An SCMP reporter rode a Pony.ai robotaxi in Shenzhen, with an empty driver's seat and a steering wheel turning on its own. The piece describes how quickly the unease faded once the car joined traffic.

items.headline: US memo says a Chinese executive was recruited to spy on Nvidia's CEO
items.summary: A US intelligence memo circulated earlier this year reportedly claims China's Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive at Megaspeed for the task. The claim comes from the memo as reported, not from a public finding.

items.headline: Qiming-backed Nature Select raises $100 million for an AI social app
items.summary: The startup has raised $100 million to build an AI-driven social app, with backing from venture firm Qiming.
